about_lc: Self Protect - Emergency Safety App Self Protect is the security app for public safety, especially women's safety. In case of self-protection, the user must always keep the app active by installing the app on the mobile (smartphone) in order to use the app. In case of any danger, by pressing the power button of the smartphone 3/4 times in a row, will immediately send the required message along with audio, footage and location map of the person to the nearest law enforcement agency along with friends and family numbers. Even if the SIM of the phone is changed after the theft of the mobile phone, the message from the app will reach the location of the lost phone to another mobile number of the family, along with the new SIM number used by the thief. This will also increase the chances of arresting the culprit. The user does not need to have any internet connection or data to use the app. This means that even if the user's internet connection is off, the message will reach the nearest police station with the help of the service provider or mobile operator to stay on GPS. If the SIM is changed after the hijacker takes the mobile phone, the location of the mobile phone will be automatically transferred from the app to the police server application. This will make it possible to know the location of the snatcher and arrest him. Users can even take the help of emergency services like hospital, fire service, ambulance, blood bank etc. with one click through this app. In addition, they can get the required service with one click from the nearest hospital, fire service, ambulance, ATM booth, bank, residential hotel, restaurant, shopping mall etc. The app can also provide necessary complaints and opinions to law enforcement agencies, the Human Rights Commission, the Legal Aid Center, and the Anti-Corruption Commission.

Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl die akute medizinische Versorgung als auch umfassende Programme zur Vorsorge und Gesundheitsförderung. about_lc: BOWLEN NIEUWE STIJL Lucky’s Bowling kan met recht een designbowlingbaan worden genoemd en is daarmee een uniek in Nederland. Uniek is ook de metersgrote videowall, waarop speciaal ontworpen animatievideo’s worden geprojecteerd. Na of tijdens het bowlen zin in een diner bereid met verse, hoogwaardige producten? Lucky’s Bowling staat garant voor een unieke ervaring, waarbij kwaliteit in al zijn facetten hoog aangeschreven staat. En dat voor prijzen die niet hoger zijn dan de reguliere bowlingbanen.
